notes.title: Cooking Strike Challenge
notes.notes:
Jane’s been asked to shoot a TV program called “Cooking Strike” to show off her incredible cooking skills, and she needs to complete five levels in a row to make sure she’s ready!

While you complete the levels to get ready for the show, the TV crew will bring some more professional equipment.

If you fail a level, your progress will be reset and you’ll have to start from the beginning!
You can try as many times as you want. The TV show’s paying for the food, so you won’t be using yours up.

When you finish the fifth level you’ll receive a big reward that includes booster parts, Coins, Rubies, and blog points!



If you don’t complete all the levels before the event ends, don’t worry. You aren’t losing anything, and there’ll always be another TV program!

notes.title: Cooking Strike Challenge
notes.notes:
Join Jane on her thrilling culinary quest in the "Cooking Strike" TV program, where she'll showcase her extraordinary skills in a series of five challenging levels. As Jane preps for her big debut, the production crew will up the ante by introducing professional-grade equipment, making each episode more enthralling.

With new, demanding challenges introduced every few days, Jane must stay sharp.

Conquer all five levels and you’ll be rewarded handsomely with booster parts, coins, rubies, and valuable blog points. And if you don’t make it this time, no worries—there’s always another show waiting for your skills to shine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157681/17519bae056b5467aaa94458554007b095294ca0.png[/img]

notes.title: Around the World
notes.notes:
Embark on a global journey with our board game, "Around the World!" This event, spanning several days, allows you to complete up to three circuits of our exciting world map.

Navigate the board by using tickets to roll the dice, with each roll moving you forward by the number shown. Earn more tickets by:

Playing levels—look for a tag on each level indicating the number of tickets you can win.
Completing daily and weekly tasks on your blog.
Enhance your adventure with a few Rainbow Tickets, each granting a free roll. For an even richer experience, consider purchasing Gold Dice, which offer fabulous perks:

Half-price dice rolls
Access to all gold rewards
Double the showplaces
Unlock additional second and third circuits.
The board features 60 spaces, each offering a different surprise:

Some spaces are empty, adding suspense.
Others grant rewards or feature showplaces.
Certain spaces may propel you forward or send you back.
Complete each circuit to win a reward! Additional circuits can be unlocked with Rubies. If you miss any special rewards on your current circuit, they’ll be safely stored in the Golden Cage and available after completing the third lap.

This thrilling event could reward you with:

Booster parts
Time-limited boosters
Full boosters
Groceries
Blog points
Coins
Rubies
Collections


Have a wonderful trip Around the World!

notes.notes:

Half-price dice rolls
Access to all gold rewards
Double the showplaces
Unlock additional second and third circuits.
The board features 60 spaces, each offering a different surprise:

Some spaces are empty, adding suspense.
Others grant rewards or feature showplaces.
Certain spaces may propel you forward or send you back.
Complete each circuit to win a reward! Additional circuits can be unlocked with Rubies. If you miss any special rewards on your current circuit, they’ll be safely stored in the Golden Cage and available after completing the third lap.

This thrilling event could reward you with:

Booster parts
Time-limited boosters
Full boosters
Groceries
Blog points
Coins
Rubies
Collections


Have a wonderful trip Around the World!

notes.title: Around the World
notes.notes:
Embark on a global journey with our board game, "Around the World!" This event, spanning several days, allows you to complete up to three circuits of our exciting world map.

Navigate the board by using tickets to roll the dice, with each roll moving you forward by the number shown. Earn more tickets by:

Playing levels—look for a tag on each level indicating the number of tickets you can win.
Completing daily and weekly tasks on your blog.
Enhance your adventure with a few Rainbow Tickets, each granting a free roll. For an even richer experience, consider purchasing Gold Dice, which offer fabulous perks:

Half-price dice rolls
Access to all gold rewards
Double the showplaces
Unlock additional second and third circuits.
The board features 60 spaces, each offering a different surprise:

Some spaces are empty, adding suspense.
Others grant rewards or feature showplaces.
Certain spaces may propel you forward or send you back.
Complete each circuit to win a reward! Additional circuits can be unlocked with Rubies. If you miss any special rewards on your current circuit, they’ll be safely stored in the Golden Cage and available after completing the third lap.

This thrilling event could reward you with:

Booster parts
Time-limited boosters
Full boosters
Groceries
Blog points
Coins
Rubies
Collections


Have a wonderful trip Around the World!

notes.notes:
Embark on a global journey with our board game, "Around the World!" This event, spanning several days, allows you to complete up to three circuits of our exciting world map.

Navigate the board by using tickets to roll the dice, with each roll moving you forward by the number shown. Earn more tickets by:

Half-price dice rolls
Access to all gold rewards
Double the showplaces

Some spaces are empty, adding suspense.
Others grant rewards or feature showplaces.
Certain spaces may propel you forward or send you back.
Complete each circuit to win a reward! Additional circuits can be unlocked with Rubies. If you miss any special rewards on your current circuit, they’ll be safely stored in the Golden Cage and available after completing the third lap.

This thrilling event could reward you with:

Booster parts
Time-limited boosters
Full boosters
Groceries
Blog points
Coins
Rubies
Collections

notes.title: Around the World
notes.notes:
Embark on a global journey with our board game, "Around the World!" This event, spanning several days, allows you to complete up to three circuits of our exciting world map.

Navigate the board by using tickets to roll the dice, with each roll moving you forward by the number shown. Earn more tickets by:

Playing levels—look for a tag on each level indicating the number of tickets you can win.
Completing daily and weekly tasks on your blog.
Enhance your adventure with a few Rainbow Tickets, each granting a free roll. For an even richer experience, consider purchasing Gold Dice, which offer fabulous perks:

Half-price dice rolls
Access to all gold rewards
Double the showplaces
Unlock additional second and third circuits.
The board features 60 spaces, each offering a different surprise:

Some spaces are empty, adding suspense.
Others grant rewards or feature showplaces.
Certain spaces may propel you forward or send you back.
Complete each circuit to win a reward! Additional circuits can be unlocked with Rubies. If you miss any special rewards on your current circuit, they’ll be safely stored in the Golden Cage and available after completing the third lap.

This thrilling event could reward you with:

Booster parts
Time-limited boosters
Full boosters
Groceries
Blog points
Coins
Rubies
Collections


Have a wonderful trip Around the World!
